ValidationRule.description: LedgerForce-owned fields change only through the LedgerForce integration user (custom permission LF_Integration_Write). Design §5.4, DL-0097.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.LF_Integration_Write), OR( ISCHANGED(LF_Balance_Due__c), ISCHANGED(LF_Overdue_Amount__c), ISCHANGED(LF_Credit_Status__c), ISCHANGED(LF_Last_Payment_Date__c), AND(ISNEW(), NOT(ISBLANK(LF_Balance_Due__c))), AND(ISNEW(), NOT(ISBLANK(LF_Overdue_Amount__c))), AND(ISNEW(), NOT(ISBLANK(LF_Credit_Status__c))), AND(ISNEW(), NOT(ISBLANK(LF_Last_Payment_Date__c))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This value is maintained by LedgerForce and is read-only in Salesforce. Make the change in LedgerForce.
